questions.text: What does Samal Bekova study at WKU?
questions.hint: "Samal Bekova studies ECONOMICS at WKU in Uralsk — she is in her second year."

questions.text: Samal has lectures on Tuesday afternoons.
questions.hint: "On TUESDAY AFTERNOONS, Samal studies in the library." — she has lectures on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, not Tuesday.

questions.text: What does Samal do on Thursday evenings?
opts: Goes to the Student Music Club
questions.correct: Goes to the Student Music Club
questions.hint: "On Thursday evenings, Samal goes to the WKU Student Music Club — she plays the guitar a little."

questions.text: Samal comes from ___, a city on the Caspian Sea in western Kazakhstan.
questions.hint: "Samal Bekova comes from AKTAU, on the Caspian Sea in western Kazakhstan."

questions.text: What was the weather like last Saturday when Samal and Aigerim went out?
opts: Cold and windy — minus three degrees
questions.correct: Cold and windy — minus three degrees
questions.hint: "Last Saturday was cold (MINUS THREE DEGREES) and windy. They wore their warmest coats and scarves."

questions.text: Samal is going to apply for a scholarship next October.
questions.hint: "She is going to apply for a scholarship in SEPTEMBER." — Not October. The deadline is in September.

questions.text: After she graduates, Samal wants to work as an economist in her hometown of ___.
questions.hint: "After graduation, Samal is going to work in AKTAU and help her community." — she is going back to where she came from.

questions.text: Samal is planning to leave Kazakhstan after she finishes university.
questions.hint: "She is NOT going to leave Kazakhstan — her country needs people like her." — clear statement of her intention to stay.

questions.text: Choose the correct form: "There ___ a beautiful park next to the university."
questions.hint: "There IS a park" — singular noun (a park) → There IS. "There ARE parks" → plural. Module 8: there is / there are.

questions.text: "She can plays the guitar very well" is correct English.
questions.hint: FALSE! After CAN, always use the BASE form (no -s, no -ing, no -ed). ✅ "She CAN PLAY the guitar." ❌ "She can plays" — Module 5: can/can't.

questions.text: Samal's friend asks: "How ___ students are in your Economics group?"
questions.hint: "How MANY students?" — students = countable plural → MANY. "How MUCH water?" → uncountable. Module 7: how much / how many.

questions.text: Last Saturday, Samal and Aigerim ___ to the market and ___ apples.
questions.hint: "Last Saturday" = Past Simple signal. walk → walked ✅, buy → bought (irregular!). Module 11: Past Simple.

questions.text: Yesterday was cold, but today is ___ than yesterday.
questions.hint: warm = short adjective (1 syllable) → comparative: warm + ER = WARMER. ✅ Comparing 2 days → comparative. Module 14: comparative adjectives.

questions.text: Samal ___ (study) in the library every Tuesday afternoon. It is her routine.
questions.hint: Present Simple for routines/habits. She (3rd person singular) + study → STUDIES (consonant + y → -ies). "Every Tuesday" = routine. Module 4: Present Simple.

questions.text: "___ there any students in the lecture hall?" — "No, ___ aren't any."
questions.hint: "ARE there any students?" (plural) → "No, there AREN'T any." ✅ Module 8: questions and negatives with there is/are.

questions.text: "What are you doing right now?" is the correct way to ask about a current action.
questions.hint: TRUE! "What ARE you DOING right now?" — Present Continuous for actions happening NOW. am/is/are + verb-ing. Module 9: Present Continuous.

questions.text: Samal ___ (not / leave) Kazakhstan after graduation — she wants to stay and work there.
questions.hint: Future plan (already decided) → GOING TO. Negative 3rd person: ISN'T going to + base verb. "She ISN'T GOING TO LEAVE." ✅ Module 15: going to.

questions.text: Last year, the winter ___ very harsh in Uralsk. The temperature ___ minus twenty.
questions.hint: "Last year" = past. "The winter WAS harsh." "The temperature WAS minus twenty." — singular subjects → WAS. Module 10: was / were.

questions.text: January is ___ month of the year in Uralsk — temperatures can reach minus thirty.
questions.hint: Superlative (among ALL months) → THE + adjective + EST: THE COLDEST. ✅ Not comparative ("colder") — we are talking about the extreme, not comparing 2. Module 14.

questions.text: "I think it will rain tomorrow" uses "will" correctly for a general prediction.
questions.hint: TRUE! "I THINK it WILL rain" = general opinion/prediction without specific evidence → WILL ✅. Compare: "Look at those clouds — it's GOING TO rain!" (with evidence). Module 15: will vs going to.

questions.text: What does "breathtaking" mean?
questions.hint: "The view from Shymbulak was BREATHTAKING — the whole city far below." Module 12: travel vocabulary.

questions.text: What does "affordable" mean?
opts: Cheap enough that most people can pay for it
Free of charge with no payment needed
questions.correct: Cheap enough that most people can pay for it
questions.hint: "4,500 tenge per night — that's very AFFORDABLE!" AFFORDABLE = доступный по цене. Module 13 & 15 vocabulary.

questions.text: A "deadline" is the earliest possible time to submit something.
questions.hint: FALSE! A DEADLINE is the LATEST time — the final limit. "The scholarship deadline is October 15th." After the deadline, it's too late. Module 15 vocabulary.

questions.text: The part of a shoe or boot that touches the ground is called the ___.
questions.hint: SOLE = подошва. "The thick rubber SOLE of the boots does not slip on icy pavements." Module 14: weather and clothes vocabulary.

questions.text: What does "contribute" mean?
opts: To take money from a shared fund
To leave a place and never return
To give something to help achieve a shared goal
To compete against someone for a prize
questions.correct: To give something to help achieve a shared goal
questions.hint: "Samal wants to CONTRIBUTE to her community in Aktau." = вносить вклад. Module 15 vocabulary.

questions.text: What is an "internship"?
opts: A final exam at the end of a university course
A period of practical work experience at a company
questions.correct: A period of practical work experience at a company
questions.hint: "After I graduate, I am going to do a one-year INTERNSHIP at the hospital." Module 15 vocabulary.

questions.text: "Relentless" rain means it rains occasionally and stops frequently.
questions.hint: FALSE! RELENTLESS = never stopping, continuing without rest. "The wind in Astana is relentless — it never stops." Module 14 vocabulary.

questions.text: What does "consistent" mean?
opts: Changing your approach every single day
Doing the same thing reliably over time
Making one big effort and then stopping
questions.correct: Doing the same thing reliably over time
questions.hint: "Study consistently — not perfectly, but regularly every day." CONSISTENT = последовательный. Module 15 vocabulary.

questions.text: After all her shopping, Nursultan calculated: 15,000 − 11,450 = ___ tenge remaining.
questions.hint: 15,000 minus 11,450 = 3,550 tenge. Module 13: numbers and money. "Remaining budget after all purchases: 3,550 tenge."

questions.text: What does "essential" mean in "A good coat and boots are essential in a Uralsk winter"?
opts: Nice to have but not necessary
Absolutely necessary and cannot be done without
questions.correct: Absolutely necessary and cannot be done without
questions.hint: "The scarf, hat and gloves are absolutely ESSENTIAL." = обязательный, необходимый. Module 14 vocabulary.
